literal: Knowledge having destroyed, he knows not even if, benefit, beside he who is, speaking is duty.
translation: Even if the leader destroys good sense and remains stubbornly ignorant, it is the duty of the one beside him to speak what is beneficial.
modern: அறிவை அழித்துவிட்டு எதையும் அறியாதவராகத் தலைவர் இருந்தாலும், அவருக்கு நன்மையானவற்றை எடுத்துச் சொல்வதே அருகில் இருக்கும் அமைச்சரின் கடமையாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the unwavering duty of a minister. The phrase 'அறிகொன்று அறியான்' describes a leader who actively rejects good sense and remains stubbornly ignorant. Even in such frustrating circumstances, the minister, denoted by 'உழையிருந்தான்' (the one who is beside), must not give up. Their fundamental duty ('கடன்') is to continue speaking words of true benefit ('உறுதி') to guide the leader.
